name: Kumartuli, Bagbazar & Hatibagan
vibe: Bonedi bari, Kumartuli artisans, and the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Narrow lanes, deep tradition.
walk_tip: Take the Blue Line to Sovabazar or Shyambazar. The lanes off Rabindra Sarani and Bidhan Sarani are closed to cars most evenings.

name: College Street & Sealdah
vibe: Theme giants: Md. Ali Park, College Square and Santosh Mitra Square. Huge queues and huge spectacle.
walk_tip: Use MG Road, Central or Sealdah. Go before 8 am or after 1 am if you want short queues.

name: Gariahat & Ballygunge
vibe: Ekdalia, Singhi Park and Ballygunge Cultural. Classic South Kolkata grandeur with lots of food around.
walk_tip: Park at South City or Quest and walk the Gariahat loop. Gariahat Road becomes one-way after 4 pm.

name: Lake Market & Kalighat
vibe: Tridhara, 66 Pally, Maddox Square, Badamtala and Chetla. The densest cluster in the city.
walk_tip: The Blue Line stations Kalighat, Rabindra Sarobar and Jatin Das Park all drop you right into the cluster. Lake Mall has paid parking.

name: Behala & New Alipore
vibe: Suruchi Sangha, Barisha and Behala Notun Dal. Theme-heavy and a little less crowded.
walk_tip: The Purple Line runs from Taratala to Behala Chowrasta. Cars are fine before 5 pm.

name: Salt Lake
vibe: FD, BJ and AE Blocks. Wide roads, well organised, family friendly.
walk_tip: Green Line to City Centre. Cars are OK, and City Centre has paid parking.

name: Lake Town & Dum Dum
vibe: Sreebhumi and the Dum Dum Park theme row. Insta-famous replicas and art installations.
walk_tip: VIP Road jams up for kilometres around Sreebhumi. Take the metro to Dum Dum and then an auto, or park at Diamond Plaza.

name: Bhowanipore & Elgin
vibe: Maddox Square adda, Bakulbagan, Chakraberia and 75 Pally. Old South Kolkata paras.
walk_tip: Jatin Das Park and Netaji Bhavan metro stations put you right in the middle. Forum Mall has paid parking.

name: Kasba & Bosepukur
vibe: The Bosepukur pujas and Rajdanga, famous for pandals made of unusual materials.
walk_tip: Take the Orange Line to Ruby (Hemanta Mukhopadhyay), or an auto from Gariahat.

name: Jadavpur & Santoshpur
vibe: Selimpur, Santoshpur Lake Pally and Trikon Park. A dense cluster of theme pujas.
walk_tip: Autos run from Gariahat to Jadavpur (8B). Jadavpur and Dhakuria suburban stations are close.

name: Tollygunge & Naktala
vibe: Naktala Udayan Sangha and the pujas along the Blue Line south.
walk_tip: Blue Line to Gitanjali or Netaji. Autos run from Tollygunge Phari.

name: Beleghata & Phoolbagan
vibe: Neighbourhood theme pujas between Sealdah and Salt Lake.
walk_tip: Green Line to Phoolbagan, or the Orange Line to Beleghata.

name: Baguiati & Kestopur
vibe: The Arjunpur and Kestopur theme pujas off VIP Road.
walk_tip: VIP Road jams in the evening. Autos and buses run from Ultadanga and Baguiati.

name: New Town
vibe: Wide roads and planned blocks, with newer pujas and less crush.
walk_tip: Drive or take a cab. Parking is easy compared with the old city.

name: Howrah: Shibpur, Salkia & Liluah
vibe: Pujas across the river, from Shibpur and Salkia up to Liluah, Belur and Bally, with a quieter, local feel.
walk_tip: Take the Green Line under the river to Howrah, or a ferry from the ghats. For Liluah, Belur and Bally, take a local train from Howrah. Then walk or take a toto.
